description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableCursorOption' which implements the 'CursorOption' interface. It encapsulates a 'cursor' string value and provides methods for creating instances, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableCursorOption
classes.description: An immutable final class implementing CursorOption, encapsulating a cursor string with factory method and standard overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableCursorOption instance with the provided cursor string.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor and invokes its visit method with this instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ImmutableCursorOption instances based on the cursor string.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns the cursor string encapsulated by this object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce a hash based on the cursor string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cursor value.
